notes: Woodshed phase two: ALL 40 PAS rudiments (sticking, accents, and flam/drag grace notes drawn on the highway — grace spacing scored in the 15-60ms pocket). GUITAR AND DRUMS NOW SCORE FROM SOUND: tap the mic chip in a session and play your real instrument — guitar via pitch detection (confidence-gated so shaky frames are discarded, never punished), drums via onset detection, both through the input you choose. New Settings > Audio devices panel: pick input and output interfaces, Helix/Stadium auto-detected by name, devices re-checked on plug/unplug. Guitar sessions add TAB and TAB+SHEET display modes with string/fret bubbles. Reports grew accent-pattern match, dynamics match, and flam-spacing lines. Shed takes now carry miss markers into your Studio Ideas.
